story:
Ethan [emotion:QT/happy] loved art class, especially when Mr. Harrison announced, "Today, we will build amazing dinosaur models for our display board!" [emotion:QT/afraid] Ethan felt a little nervous because he really wanted to make a perfect *Stegosaurus* with its spiky plates and long tail. He thought, "I want mine to be the best *Stegosaurus*!" He went to the craft table, curious about all the colorful materials.

Mr. Harrison explained, "Remember to *share* the materials and *take turns* choosing what you need." Ethan picked up a long piece of brown construction paper for the *Stegosaurus*'s body. But then, he couldn't find any bright green pipe cleaners for the spiky plates. He looked on the tall shelf, then in the bottom drawer, but they weren't there. [emotion:QT/angry] Ethan felt frustrated, so he frowned a little, wondering where they went.

A kind girl named Maya noticed Ethan looking worried. [emotion:QT/afraid] [emotion:QT/calm] "Are you looking for something special?" she asked, her voice gentle.
Ethan pointed to his drawing. "Green... for the plates," he said, trying to make his voice clear.
[gesture:think] Maya thought for a moment. "Oh, I saw some shiny green pipe cleaners! They fell behind the big blue bin, that is why you didn't see them." [emotion:QT/happy] She went to the bin and carefully pulled out a whole bunch of bright green pipe cleaners. "Here they are!" she said, offering them to Ethan.
[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan smiled. "Thank you!" he said.
"We can *share* them," Maya suggested. "I need some for my *Triceratops* horns too."
[gesture:nodding-yes] "Okay," Ethan agreed. They sat side-by-side, carefully twisting the pipe cleaners onto their dinosaurs. They *listened* to each other's ideas about where to put the plates and horns. When a plate didn't stick well, Maya said, "Let's *try again* with more glue."

Soon, both dinosaurs were finished! Ethan's *Stegosaurus* had amazing, spiky green plates and a long, brown tail. Maya's *Triceratops* had shiny horns. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt very proud of his dinosaur, and he was grateful Maya helped him. [emotion:QT/happy] He learned that working together made the project much easier and more fun, because they could help each other. Mr. Harrison came over. [emotion:QT/happy] "Wow, Ethan, your *Stegosaurus* is wonderful! And Maya, your *Triceratops* looks super strong! You both did an excellent job collaborating." Ethan looked at Maya and gave a small, [emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:nodding-yes] happy nod.
